assumptions: Complex charged parent A and neutral real daughter B with H2† A B^2 gauge-invariant operator; H2 obtains a prescribed late VEV.
After A to 2B conversion only B has chi-dependent mass; the analyzed homogeneous equations treat A/B as pressureless matter apart from the mass-transfer term.
Decay onset and rapid rate, daughter kinematics, neglected radial-mode energy and the trigger completion are assumed rather than observationally qualified.
The source shows chosen curves for homogeneous H(z) only; external likelihoods, data and priors are not evaluated in this EFT.
The Naidoo comparison assigns a daughter EOS and constant Lambda rather than deriving those functions from the displayed quintessence EFT.
A separate U1(1) breaking supplies massive vector alpha and light radial mediator h1; vector abundance/stability and production remain to be established.
Tree-level t/u channels and source identical-particle angular weighting; massive effective cubic g, not dimensionless gauge g1.
Source plotted-relative-velocity convention and identical-particle normalization must be resolved before interpreting numeric cross sections.

minimal_test.question: Derive the retained-sector continuity system from stated mass function and operator, establish cancellation of all source terms, and specify decay recoil/energy allocation and transition/radial-mode contributions before comparing a common-normalization H(z). Audit any claimed fit transfer against the actual set of observables in the source likelihood. Treat SIDM as a separate follow-up requiring cubic-coupling units, velocity definition and identical-particle normalization.
observables: sum of retained-sector energy source terms
likelihood scope of claimed external fit match
minimal_test.scope: Conceptual source/method test only. Values, implementation, production tolerances and accepted consumer inputs remain unspecified.

simplifications: Background conservation does not establish perturbation equivalence, data fit, fifth-force viability or a transition UV completion.
No transfer of Agrawal/Naidoo likelihood results or core-formation claims.
data_dependencies: Pinned EFT paper and local source equations. External fit papers, code, chains, data likelihoods and exact ancestry are unacquired/unverified here.
unknowns: Higgs-trigger dynamics and transition energy budget.
Parent/daughter masses, recoil, pressure and production distributions.
Radial-mode channel branching and coupling radiative stability.
Perturbation closure and observational likelihood differences.
verification_gates: Reconcile source conventions and maintain the original-versus-repaired equation distinction.
Inspect current compiled consumer capabilities and freeze inputs/reference cases before constructing any executable request.
Keep analytic/numerical verification, observation lineage, inference validity and scientific interpretation separate.
falsification: Failure of retained-sector source cancellation rejects that specified system; a successful background match still cannot validate transfer of CMB/BAO/SN likelihood evidence or SIDM structure formation.
